# Framing record: Rotate the widget key

## Who arrives, from where, and why

Operators arrive from the alert that the key expires soon. They rotate the key `key-ttl`
before it lapses.

## Background the page rests on

The widget reads its key at start.

The old key stays valid for one day.

## Place in the doc set

Sits after the install guide and before the reference.

## Intro plan

Open with the one command, then the check.

## Departures from the plan's introduction

The planning session dropped the "why rotate" paragraph, since the alert already says it.
